description:
AI notetaker that records, transcribes, and summarizes your meetings.

The Fireflies.ai desktop app is an AI notetaker that captures, transcribes, and summarizes meetings. It provides live transcripts, automatic meeting notes and summaries, instant answers from live meetings and past syncs with AskFred, mid-call AI skills, botless meetings, and real-time sales assistance that searches past meetings and knowledge bases.
